erc-3009.title: ERC-3009 transferWithAuthorization
erc-3009.summary: A token transfer authorised by an off-chain EIP-712 signature and submitted by anyone; the x402 exact scheme on EVM uses it for USDC.

x402-v2.title: x402 protocol version 2
x402-v2.summary: HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE request header and a PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header.

eip-712.title: EIP-712 typed data
eip-712.summary: Structured data signing with a domain separator bound to a chain id and a verifying contract.
